requirements.title: MOD argument restrictions
requirements.definition: A shall be integer or real; P shall have the same type and kind type parameter as A and shall not be zero.

pending.MOD-P-same-type-kind-as-A: Positive source controls call MOD with same-kind integer operands and same-kind real operands. A source-control mutation changes only P kind and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MOD-P-nonzero: Positive source controls use nonzero positive and negative P values. A source-control mutation uses P=0 and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MOD integer result follows A minus truncated quotient times P
requirements.definition: For integer operands, the value of MOD(A,P) is A minus INT(A/P) times P.

pending.MOD-integer-positive-operands: Use MOD(8,5) expecting exact integer 3; mutate the intrinsic to MODULO so a companion negative case fails.
pending.MOD-integer-negative-A: Use MOD(-8,5) expecting exact integer -3, distinguishing truncated quotient semantics from floor semantics.
pending.MOD-integer-negative-P: Use MOD(8,-5) expecting exact integer 3, paired with the negative-A companion so argument order and sign handling are load-bearing.
pending.MOD-integer-both-negative: Use MOD(-8,-5) expecting exact integer -3, paired with positive operands so sign behavior is nonvacuous.

Future fixtures may check type and kind plus separately justified bounded properties, never a required rounded real value.
